content.text: Great. Oh, and the charger was faulty too, can you refund that separately as well?

I’m glad the stand refund is all set! Since the entire order (including the charger) has already been refunded in full, we can’t issue a second, separate refund for the charger. The €88.00 refund covers both items.

If there’s anything else you need help with, just let me know!

We already refunded full order, which includes charger. Policy: one refund per order (or per item when refunding a single item). Since full order already refunded, cannot refund charger separately. Need to explain politely. Possibly offer to check if they want partial refund instead, but full already done. So we must inform cannot refund again. Offer to handoff if they dispute. Probably just explain.
